'''Iguanas''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] kept [[Chirpa's iguana/Legends|one]] such iguana, who served as both his pet and [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]].

==Biology and appearance==
Iguanas were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]]<ref name="Blog" /> quadrupeds, the body of which was covered in fine scales. They had a spiny crest along the back and a thin, long tail banded alternatively in different [[Color/Legends|colors]]. At least one known iguana was gray with dark brown scales on the tail. The body of an iguana was about the length of an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok's]] head, not including the tail.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==History==
The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], kept an [[Chirpa's iguana/Legends|iguana]] with grey scales as his pet and [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. The Chief showed affection to his iguana, as he would let it clamber over his head during sessions of his tribe's [[Council of Elders (Ewok)/Legends|Council of Elders]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The novelization mentions that this reptile is not only Chirpa's pet, but also his advisor. It is unknown whether the advice went further than the taste of delicious plants and leaves (the iguana is a herbivore)|Tim Veekhoven and Mark Newbold|<ref name="Blog" />}}
An iguana first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the third installment of the [[Original trilogy|original ''Star Wars'' trilogy]], which was released in [[1983]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novel adaptation]] of ''Return of the Jedi'' said Chirpa's iguana was "his pet and advisor." A literal reading of this phrase implies that iguanas can think and communicate concepts, and thus are at least semi-sentient, but that not all the narration in the novel is meant to be read literally is evidenced by such lines as "[[C-3PO/Legends|Threepio]]&hellip; smiled apologetically."<ref name="ROTJN" />

In [[2013]], [[Tim Veekhoven]] and [[Mark Newbold]] mentioned Chirpa's iguana in "[[Back from the Drawing Board|Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]," an article written for the [[Star Wars Blog]]. The article mentioned the iguana's uncertain level of sentience and joked about the creature agreeing to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Blog" />
